subtasks.name: Grasp the tools
subtasks.instruction: Grasp the dustpan handle with the {pan} gripper, then grasp the brush handle with the {brush} gripper.
subtasks.goal: The arm on the dustpan side holds the dustpan by its handle and the other arm holds the brush by its handle (gripper readings: about 0.32 on the dustpan arm, about 0.23 on the brush arm).

subtasks.name: Sweep the paper balls into the dustpan
subtasks.instruction: Sweep all the paper balls into the dustpan with the brush.
subtasks.goal: Every paper ball that was on the table is inside the dustpan. If a ball is missed or rolls out, this subtask is not done.

subtasks.name: Lift the dustpan over the basket and pour
subtasks.instruction: Lift the dustpan over the basket and pour the paper balls into the basket.
subtasks.goal: The dustpan has been lifted over the white basket and tipped, and every paper ball has fallen into the basket.

subtasks.name: Put the tools down and return home
subtasks.instruction: Put the dustpan and the brush down on the table, then return both arms home and stay still.
subtasks.goal: The dustpan and the brush lie on the table, both grippers have let go (they read 0 again), and both arms are back at their start pose and still. When this is done the whole task is complete.
